record.question: Who firstly rename the so called 'Look East Policy' to 'Act East Policy'?
record.explanation: Answer A: Narendra Modi. Narendra Modi announced India's formal Act East Policy in November 2014. The Foreign Ministry's contemporary presentation credits that policy transition to him. This does not mean he coined the words act east: Hillary Clinton had used that exhortation in a 2011 speech, also printed as a distractor here. Historical/source note: Answer refers to formal Indian government policy adoption/renaming in 2014, not first utterance or coinage of act east. Reference: https://www.mea.gov.in/images/pdf1/r_v_30_03_2015.pdf; https://2009-2017.state.gov/secretary/20092013clinton/rm/2011/07/168840.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
